req.title: Task title max length
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title exceeds the maximum length constraint.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states the system must return HTTP 422 when the task title exceeds the maximum length constraint. From schemas.py, TaskBase.title has max_length=100. Tests must cover: (1) positive case — title at exactly 100 chars is accepted with HTTP 201, (2) boundary case — title at exactly 101 chars is rejected with HTTP 422, (3) negative case — title well over max (130 chars from invalid data) is rejected with HTTP 422. Additional boundary tests at 99 chars (accepted) and 100 chars (accepted, catches >= vs > mutation) strengthen mutation resilience. All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient with SQLite in-memory override to avoid state pollution.

tests.name: test_create_task_title_exactly_100_chars_accepted
preconditions: Database is available with schema created
Title length is exactly 100 characters (max_length boundary)
actions: POST /tasks/ with title of exactly 100 characters and valid completed field
expected: Response body contains the title field equal to the 100-char string
Response body contains id, created_at fields
trace: R-TASK-029: max_length=100 in TaskBase.title; exactly 100 chars must be accepted
tests.executable:
import os, tempfile
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

tf = tempfile.mktemp(suffix='.db')
engine = create_engine(f'sqlite:///{tf}', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
TestingSession = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSession()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

title_100 = 'A' * 100
assert len(title_100) == 100
response = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': title_100, 'completed': False})
assert response.status_code == 201
body = response.json()
assert body['title'] == title_100
assert 'id' in body
assert 'created_at' in body

app.dependency_overrides.clear()
os.unlink(tf)
